race.comment: SWIFT DUKE (3) has improved at each appearance this prep, the latest offering an eye-catching second over 1200m at Doomben. Comes back a little in trip but should race handy from the good draw and will be tough to hold out. ARMAND (10) was in the market on debut last time out over this distance at Gatton and got the job done, albeit by just 0.6 lengths. Much tougher this time but in good hands and should make plenty of progress. THE GRAND DUCHY (5) led and gave nothing else a chance in an Ipswich maiden over today's journey last start. Putting it together this prep and a race like this is not out of reach. Genuine mare MISS WILDCAT (8) resumes after an 18-week spell. Trialled well recently and should be in the thick of things. ZAVEGA (12) scored at Dalby last start when coming off a two-month let-up. Should tighten up following that hit-out and is in contention again.
